question: What are the capital adequacy requirements for Tier 1 under Basel III as amended in 2023?
answer: Tier 1 capital must be at least 6% of RWA. [S1] The eligible capital base is redefined as effective Tier 1 capital, with allowances for capital infused after the balance sheet date and, for Indian banks, profits accrued during the year. [S2] At consolidated level a bank compares its aggregate group exposures to third parties with the group's Tier 1 capital. [S3]

citations.label: S1
citations.reference: BCBS Basel Framework, RBC20 (published 2020-11-26, effective 2023-01-01); RBC30 (version effective 2019-12-15)
